In addition, our 24/7 team is always by the phone and are stoked to serve you, so give us a call if you need something after hours!

name: Renovated Deluxe Queens
address: 762 South Main Street,  Cascade, Idaho, United States
description:
We are Cascade's first Contactless Hotel!
Contactless makes things simple, what it means is that you will receive a door code for your reserved room on the day of check in! No need to come to reception unless you want to meet our friendly staff and get local recommendations for food, libations, adventures and more! Please check your email to see an even warmer welcome on history, what to expect, and more. See you soon!

Nestled just north of Boise and steps away from the tranquil shores of Lake Cascade, Birch Glen Lodge offers a serene mountain getaway with warm hospitality. Established in 1968, our scenic property has been a cherished retreat for outdoor enthusiasts seeking camping, fishing, hiking, and endless outdoor adventures. Located next to Kelly's Whitewater Park, Birch Glen Lodge is surrounded by the picturesque mountains, providing a perfect blend of privacy, relaxation, and entertainment.

Birch Glen Lodge is an ideal destination for romantic weekends, family vacations, corporate retreats, reunions, or simply a peaceful escape from the city’s hustle and bustle. Whether you seek the tranquility of your room or the excitement of nearby activities, Birch Glen Lodge caters to all preferences. Inside the lodge, guests can unwind with amenities such as pool tables, cozy sitting areas, large screen TVs, and card tables. Outside, enjoy the barbecue area, fire pit with ample seating, expansive grassy area, and horseshoes, ensuring any gathering is a success.

At Birch Glen Lodge, we treat our guests like family, striving to make you feel as comfortable as you do at home. Come experience the unique charm and welcoming atmosphere of Birch Glen Lodge—your perfect mountain retreat.

Stay in a place where adventure meets relaxation. The Placencia offers the best of Belize with all the comforts of home. Nestled on Maya Beach, the resort is just a short ride away from Placencia Village, where you can enjoy beach bars and local shopping.

Step outside to unwind on the white sand beach. Spend the day at the beach and work on your tan with sun loungers (chaise lounges) or relax in the shade with umbrellas. At The Placencia Resort, pamper yourself with a treatment at the full-service spa or have fun in the sun with activities like kayaking and volleyball. Guests can unwind with a drink at one of the resort's three bars.

The Placencia Resort provides the amenities of a resort coupled with exhilarating adventures that can be enjoyed by couples, friends and families. The resort boasts one of the largest pools in Belize and a beautiful private beach. Take a dip or simply lay by the pool for a perfect day of relaxing. Utilize the complimentary kayaks, paddle boards, and other beach toys for a day of fun in the sun. 

When you're ready to see more of Belize, our concierge is ready to assist! The Placencia is perfectly situated for easy access to jungle adventures, ancient Maya sites, and ocean adventures (don't forget about the fishing!). We offer every bucket list activity you can think of!

Join us on property at one of our resort restaurants for exquisite cuisine and enjoy the best seat in the house, whether it's your first stop of the day, your last stop or anywhere in-between. There is something for everyone here.

description:
Stay in a place where adventure meets relaxation. The Placencia offers the best of Belize with all the comforts of home. Nestled on Maya Beach, the resort is just a short ride away from Placencia Village, where you can enjoy beach bars and local shopping.

Step outside to unwind on the white sand beach. Spend the day at the beach and work on your tan with sun loungers (chaise lounges) or relax in the shade with umbrellas. At The Placencia Resort, pamper yourself with a treatment at the full-service spa or have fun in the sun with activities like kayaking and volleyball. Guests can unwind with a drink at one of the resort's three bars.

The Placencia Resort provides the amenities of a resort coupled with exhilarating adventures that can be enjoyed by couples, friends and families. The resort boasts one of the largest pools in Belize and a beautiful private beach. Take a dip or simply lay by the pool for a perfect day of relaxing. Utilize the complimentary kayaks, paddle boards, and other beach toys for a day of fun in the sun. 

When you're ready to see more of Belize, our concierge is ready to assist! The Placencia is perfectly situated for easy access to jungle adventures, ancient Maya sites, and ocean adventures (don't forget about the fishing!). We offer every bucket list activity you can think of!

Join us on property at one of our resort restaurants for exquisite cuisine and enjoy the best seat in the house, whether it's your first stop of the day, your last stop or anywhere in-between. There is something for everyone here.

It primarily serves as the home venue for the New Orleans Saints of the National Football League (NFL), and is also the home stadium for the Sugar Bowl and New Orleans Bowl in college football.
